rows.Name: ID
rows.Description: The ID of the sheet. Should be unique within a project. All operations use ID to confirm the scope.

rows.Name: Number
rows.Description:
The number of the sheet, a human-readable identifier. Shows as primary description of Number column in Forma Sheets UI.
The number is automatically extracted from the sheet’s title block and can be updated on demand.

rows.Name: Title
rows.Description:
The title of the sheet. Shows as secondary description of Number column in Forma Sheets UI.
The title is automatically extracted from the sheet title block and can be updated on demand.

rows.Name: Tags
rows.Description: A list of user defined tags of the sheet.

rows.Name: Version Set ID
rows.Description: The ID of the version set that the sheet belongs to.

rows.Name: Viewable
rows.Description: The URN and view GUID that can be used to load the view in Viewer.

rows.Name: ID
rows.Description: The ID of the version set. Should be unique within a project. All operations use ID to confirm the scope.

rows.Name: Name
rows.Description: The name of the version set, a human-readable identifier. Should be unique within the project.

rows.Name: Issuance Date
rows.Description: Represents the date that the sheets are issued to other project members. Determines attribute current of sheets, please refer to Current Sheets section.

rows.Name: ID
rows.Description: The ID of the upload. Should be unique within a project. All operations use ID to confirm the scope.

rows.Name: Version Set ID
rows.Description: The ID of the version set that will contain all the sheets published by the upload.

rows.Name: Status
rows.Description:
The status of the upload, changes according to API call and processing status.
Possible values: PENDING, PROCESSING, IN_REVIEW, FAILED, UPDATING_VERSION_SET, PUBLISHING, PUBLISHED.

rows.Name: ID
rows.Description: The ID of the review sheet.

rows.Name: Number
rows.Description: The number of the review sheet, will be inherit by the published sheet.

rows.Name: Title
rows.Description: The title of the review sheet, will be inherit by the published sheet.

rows.Name: Tags
rows.Description: A list of user defined tags of the review sheet, will be inherit by the published sheet.

rows.Name: Deleted
rows.Description: The deleted status of the review sheet. Review sheets marked as deleted=true will not be published.

rows.Name: Processing State
rows.Description: The processing status of the review sheet. Possible values: PROCESSING, ROTATING, AUDITING, READY, FAILED, PUBLISHING.
Markups visible to all project members.
Markups visible only to their creator.
Links added manually to a standard markup, including links to Sheets, Files, RFIs, Forms, Submittals, and Assets.
Issues visible to anyone with the correct permission on your project.
Issues visible only to the issue markup creator and the assignee.
Photos visible to anyone on your project. A subscription to Autodesk Forma Build is required.
Photos visible only to the photo markup creator. A subscription to Autodesk Forma Build is required.
Markups associated with assets on the sheet. A subscription to Autodesk Forma Build is required.

rows.Name: ID
rows.Description: The unique identifier for the collection within a project. Used to reference the collection in all operations.

rows.Name: Name
rows.Description: A human-readable identifier for the collection. Displays as the primary description in the Name column of the Forma Sheets UI.
